summary: Sanction to connect household drainage pipe to municipal underground sewer mains.

steps.title: Prepare internal plumbing blueprint
steps.description: Plumbing map showing inspection chambers, slope gradients, and gully trap locations.

steps.title: Submit municipal application
steps.description: Submit building sanction letter, water connection receipt, and road cutting permission request.

steps.title: Junior Engineer field inspection
steps.description: JE measures distance from property boundary to sewer manhole and estimates road restoration fee.

steps.title: Payment of road restoration charges
steps.description: Pay connection fee and road restoration deposit at municipal citizen service counter.

steps.title: Supervised connection & sealing
steps.description: Licensed plumber executes pipeline hookup to municipal manhole under junior engineer supervision.
